When you show your healthcare provider your Quest Diagnostics&nbsp;card to obtain outpatient testing, there is no cost to you!&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:madefor-text-bold,helveticaneuew01-65medi,helveticaneuew02-65medi,helveticaneuew10-65medi,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="color:#F97425;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixGuard wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">To receive the benefits of the Quest Diagnostics Advanced program,&nbsp;you must present your Quest Diagnostics® card&nbsp;or healthcare ID card with the Quest Diagnostics&nbsp;logo on it at the time of each service, and request your provider send your laboratory testing order to Quest Diagnostics.</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">The&nbsp;Quest Diagnostic Advanced Lab Program&nbsp;is also called&nbsp;QuestSelect. This program allows you to obtain outpatient laboratory testing&nbsp;at no cost to you. When your doctor orders lab testing, you can show your QuestSelect&nbsp;card and use your QuestSelect&nbsp;benefit. Your physician or phlebotomist must indicate that you have QuestSelect&nbsp;coverage on a Quest Diagnostics requisition which accompanies your specimens to Quest Diagnostics.</span></p></div><!--/$--></div></div><!--/$--></div></section><!--/$--><!--$--><section id="comp-ls9gihzm" tabindex="-1" data-block-level-container="Section" class="ke5pl1 comp-ls9gihzm You can ask your provider for a written order to have your lab work collected at an approved Quest Patient Service Center (PSC) location.</span></p></div><!--/$--><!--$--><div id="comp-ls9hacjg__item-j9ples3e" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL ZS_qLz PO9MfV comp-ls9hacjg__item-j9ples3e wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h6 class="font_6 wixui-rich-text__text">2.</h6></div><!--/$--></div></div><!--/$--><!--$--><div id="comp-ls9h9coh__item-j9plerjk" role="listitem" class="HFEOE3 NaeT1r comp-ls9h9coh__item-j9plerjk wixui-repeater__item" dir="ltr"><div aria-hidden="true" class="jdJeEr NYfD3h inner-box wixui-repeater__item"></div><div data-testid="responsive-container-content" role="group" class="comp-ls9h9coh-container"><!--$--><div id="comp-ls9h9yf1__item-j9plerjk" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL ZS_qLz PO9MfV comp-ls9h9yf1__item-j9plerjk wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text">The sample is collected at the healthcare provider's office or PSC and is sent to Quest Diagnostics for processing.</p></div><!--/$--><!--$--><div id="comp-ls9hacjg__item-j9plerjk" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL ZS_qLz PO9MfV comp-ls9hacjg__item-j9plerjk wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h6 class="font_6 wixui-rich-text__text">3.</h6></div><!--/$--></div></div><!--/$--><!--$--><div id="comp-ls9h9coh__item-ls9h9i1u" role="listitem" class="HFEOE3 NaeT1r comp-ls9h9coh__item-ls9h9i1u wixui-repeater__item" dir="ltr"><div aria-hidden="true" class="jdJeEr NYfD3h inner-box wixui-repeater__item"></div><div data-testid="responsive-container-content" role="group" class="comp-ls9h9coh-container"><!--$--><div id="comp-ls9h9yf1__item-ls9h9i1u" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL ZS_qLz PO9MfV comp-ls9h9yf1__item-ls9h9i1u wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text">Testing is completed by Quest and results are sent to your provider. wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">QuestSelectTM does not cover:</span></p>

<ul class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text">
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">Lab work ordered during hospitalization.</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">Lab work that is needed on an emergency (STAT) basis and time-sensitive, esoteric outpatient laboratory testing such as fertility testing, bone marrow studies and spinal fluid tests.</span></p>

<script id="wix-skip-played-animations">
    window.__pageRevealPromise && window.__pageRevealPromise.then(function() {
        requestAnimationFrame(function() {
            try {
                var stored = sessionStorage.getItem('wix-motion-played-animations');
                if (stored) {
                    var played = JSON.parse(stored);
                    for (var compId in played) {
                        if (played[compId]) {
                            var el = document.getElementById(compId);
                            if (el) {
                                el.dataset.motionEnter = 'done';
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (e) {}
        });
    });
</script>

<script>
			const wixAdsOffsetHeight = document.querySelector(':is(.WIX_ADS, #WIX_ADS)')?.offsetHeight || 0;
			const header = document.getElementsByTagName('header')[0];

			let headerOffsetHeight = 0;

			if (header) {
				const headerPosition = window.getComputedStyle(header).getPropertyValue('position').toLowerCase();
				const isHeaderStickyOrFixed = headerPosition === 'sticky' || headerPosition === 'fixed';
				headerOffsetHeight = isHeaderStickyOrFixed ? header.offsetHeight : 0;
			}

			document.documentElement.style.scrollPaddingTop = `${wixAdsOffsetHeight + headerOffsetHeight}px`;
        </script>

<script id="wix-first-paint">
    if (window.ResizeObserver &&
        (!window.PerformanceObserver || !PerformanceObserver.supportedEntryTypes || PerformanceObserver.supportedEntryTypes.indexOf('paint') === -1)) {
        new ResizeObserver(function (entries, observer) {
            entries.some(function (entry) {
                var contentRect = entry.contentRect;
                if (contentRect.width > 0 && contentRect.height > 0) {
                    requestAnimationFrame(function (now) {
                        window.wixFirstPaint = now;
                        dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('wixFirstPaint'));
                    });
                    observer.disconnect();
                    return true;
                }
            });
        }).observe(document.body);
    }
</script>


<script id="scroll-bar-width-calculation">
    const div = document.createElement('div')
    div.style.overflowY = 'scroll'
    div.style.width = '50px'
    div.style.height = '50px'
    div.style.visibility = 'hidden'
    document.body.appendChild(div)
    const scrollbarWidth= div.offsetWidth - div.clientWidth
    document.body.removeChild(div)
    if(scrollbarWidth > 0){
        document.body.style.setProperty('--scrollbar-width', `${scrollbarWidth}px`)
    }
</script>

When you show your healthcare provider your Quest Diagnostics&nbsp;card to obtain outpatient testing, there is no cost to you!&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:madefor-text-bold,helveticaneuew01-65medi,helveticaneuew02-65medi,helveticaneuew10-65medi,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="color:#F97425;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixGuard wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">To receive the benefits of the Quest Diagnostics Advanced program,&nbsp;you must present your Quest Diagnostics® card&nbsp;or healthcare ID card with the Quest Diagnostics&nbsp;logo on it at the time of each service, and request your provider send your laboratory testing order to Quest Diagnostics.</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">The&nbsp;Quest Diagnostic Advanced Lab Program&nbsp;is also called&nbsp;QuestSelect. This program allows you to obtain outpatient laboratory testing&nbsp;at no cost to you. When your doctor orders lab testing, you can show your QuestSelect&nbsp;card and use your QuestSelect&nbsp;benefit. Your physician or phlebotomist must indicate that you have QuestSelect&nbsp;coverage on a Quest Diagnostics requisition which accompanies your specimens to Quest Diagnostics.</span></p></div><!--/$--></div></div><!--/$--></div></section><!--/$--><!--$--><section id="comp-ls9gihzm" tabindex="-1" data-block-level-container="Section" class="ke5pl1 comp-ls9gihzm wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">QuestSelectTM does not cover:</span></p>

<ul class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text">
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">Lab work ordered during hospitalization.</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">Lab work that is needed on an emergency (STAT) basis and time-sensitive, esoteric outpatient laboratory testing such as fertility testing, bone marrow studies and spinal fluid tests.</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">Non-laboratory work such as mammography, x-ray, imaging, and dental work.</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">Lab work performed without the use of your QuestSelectTM benefit.</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">Testing that is not approved and/or covered by your current health benefit plan.</span></p>
</li>
</ul></div><!--/$--></div></div><!--/$--></div></div></li><li class="AccordionContainer1266025101__accordion wixui-accordion__item"><div><button class="AccordionContainerHeader936294312__root <script id="wix-skip-played-animations">
    window.__pageRevealPromise && window.__pageRevealPromise.then(function() {
        requestAnimationFrame(function() {
            try {
                var stored = sessionStorage.getItem('wix-motion-played-animations');
                if (stored) {
                    var played = JSON.parse(stored);
                    for (var compId in played) {
                        if (played[compId]) {
                            var el = document.getElementById(compId);
                            if (el) {
                                el.dataset.motionEnter = 'done';
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (e) {}
        });
    });
</script>

  <style id="a11y-contrast">
    @media (forced-colors: active) {
      #SITE_CONTAINER.focus-ring-active
        :not(.has-custom-focus):not(.ignore-focus):not([tabindex='-1']):focus,
      #SITE_CONTAINER.focus-ring-active
        :not(.has-custom-focus):not(.ignore-focus):not([tabindex='-1']):focus
        ~ .wixSdkShowFocusOnSibling {
        outline: 2px solid CanvasText;
        outline-offset: 2px;
      }
    }
  </style>
  

  <script id="wix-skip-played-animations-setup">
    (function() {
        var navEntry = performance.getEntriesByType('navigation')[0];
        if (navEntry && navEntry.type === 'reload') {
            return;
        }
        if ('PageRevealEvent' in window) {
            window.__pageRevealPromise = new Promise(function(resolve) {
                window.addEventListener('pagereveal', resolve, { once: true });
            });
        } else {
            window.__pageRevealPromise = Promise.resolve();
        }
    })();
  </script>

<script id="wix-first-paint">
    if (window.ResizeObserver &&
        (!window.PerformanceObserver || !PerformanceObserver.supportedEntryTypes || PerformanceObserver.supportedEntryTypes.indexOf('paint') === -1)) {
        new ResizeObserver(function (entries, observer) {
            entries.some(function (entry) {
                var contentRect = entry.contentRect;
                if (contentRect.width > 0 && contentRect.height > 0) {
                    requestAnimationFrame(function (now) {
                        window.wixFirstPaint = now;
                        dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('wixFirstPaint'));
                    });
                    observer.disconnect();
                    return true;
                }
            });
        }).observe(document.body);
    }
</script>


<script id="scroll-bar-width-calculation">
    const div = document.createElement('div')
    div.style.overflowY = 'scroll'
    div.style.width = '50px'
    div.style.height = '50px'
    div.style.visibility = 'hidden'
    document.body.appendChild(div)
    const scrollbarWidth= div.offsetWidth - div.clientWidth
    document.body.removeChild(div)
    if(scrollbarWidth > 0){
        document.body.style.setProperty('--scrollbar-width', `${scrollbarWidth}px`)
    }
</script>

When you show your healthcare provider your Quest Diagnostics&nbsp;card to obtain outpatient testing, there is no cost to you!&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:madefor-text-bold,helveticaneuew01-65medi,helveticaneuew02-65medi,helveticaneuew10-65medi,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="color:#F97425;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixGuard wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">To receive the benefits of the Quest Diagnostics Advanced program,&nbsp;you must present your Quest Diagnostics® card&nbsp;or healthcare ID card with the Quest Diagnostics&nbsp;logo on it at the time of each service, and request your provider send your laboratory testing order to Quest Diagnostics.</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">The&nbsp;Quest Diagnostic Advanced Lab Program&nbsp;is also called&nbsp;QuestSelect. This program allows you to obtain outpatient laboratory testing&nbsp;at no cost to you. When your doctor orders lab testing, you can show your QuestSelect&nbsp;card and use your QuestSelect&nbsp;benefit. Your physician or phlebotomist must indicate that you have QuestSelect&nbsp;coverage on a Quest Diagnostics requisition which accompanies your specimens to Quest Diagnostics.</span></p></div><!--/$--></div></div><!--/$--></div></section><!--/$--><!--$--><section id="comp-ls9gihzm" tabindex="-1" data-block-level-container="Section" class="ke5pl1 comp-ls9gihzm <ul class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text">
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">Lab work ordered during hospitalization.</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">Lab work that is needed on an emergency (STAT) basis and time-sensitive, esoteric outpatient laboratory testing such as fertility testing, bone marrow studies and spinal fluid tests.</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">Non-laboratory work such as mammography, x-ray, imaging, and dental work.</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">Lab work performed without the use of your QuestSelectTM benefit.</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">Testing that is not approved and/or covered by your current health benefit plan.</span></p>
</li>
</ul></div><!--/$--></div></div><!--/$--></div></div></li><li class="AccordionContainer1266025101__accordion wixui-accordion__item"><div><button class="AccordionContainerHeader936294312__root <script id="wix-skip-played-animations">
    window.__pageRevealPromise && window.__pageRevealPromise.then(function() {
        requestAnimationFrame(function() {
            try {
                var stored = sessionStorage.getItem('wix-motion-played-animations');
                if (stored) {
                    var played = JSON.parse(stored);
                    for (var compId in played) {
                        if (played[compId]) {
                            var el = document.getElementById(compId);
                            if (el) {
                                el.dataset.motionEnter = 'done';
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (e) {}
        });
    });
</script>

        <script>
			const wixAdsOffsetHeight = document.querySelector(':is(.WIX_ADS, #WIX_ADS)')?.offsetHeight || 0;
			const header = document.getElementsByTagName('header')[0];

			let headerOffsetHeight = 0;

			if (header) {
				const headerPosition = window.getComputedStyle(header).getPropertyValue('position').toLowerCase();
				const isHeaderStickyOrFixed = headerPosition === 'sticky' || headerPosition === 'fixed';
				headerOffsetHeight = isHeaderStickyOrFixed ? header.offsetHeight : 0;
			}

			document.documentElement.style.scrollPaddingTop = `${wixAdsOffsetHeight + headerOffsetHeight}px`;
        </script>
